never_touch: SEO landing-page content outside the search product
invariants: simple narrowing remains local when payload-complete
widening original constraints uses the existing server re-search lifecycle
progressive result expansion never starts a second Tourvisor search for the same searchId

AnyTour Design System 2.0 remains the only active visual system

no unrelated refactor is bundled into this task
